did.description: DID of the repository or account owner

limit.description: positive maximum in the resource's native units; cannot be combined with unlimited

resource.description: quota resource name, such as workflows, vcpus, memory_mib, disk_mib, or cache_storage_bytes

unlimited.description: store an unlimited override; cannot be combined with limit

main.description: set a quota override for a repository or account owner; values use the resource's native units
